description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.034 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Extracts structured breadcrumb navigation from a URL. Returns domain, ordered path segments with human-readable labels, query parameters as key-value pairs, and a formatted breadcrumb trail string. Identifies numeric IDs vs. named path segments. Pure URL parsing — zero external calls. Useful for agents that process sitemaps, navigation menus, or need to understand page hierarchy.
